scope: Bounded DMG Appendix C source excerpts for Appendix C character-class limits. The supplied canonical PDF omits printed p. 175; separate limited source-image crops are available for p. 175, while p. 176 excerpts come from the canonical PDF. Printing details for the supplemental image are not established. This scope does not claim completeness for the rest of Appendix C or the DMG.
